title: Love Is in Control (Finger on the Trigger)

notes.made: Temperton co-wrote it with Quincy Jones and Merria Ross, and the rhythm and vocal arrangement is credited to Jones, Temperton and James Ingram, with Jerry Hey on horns. Jones produced and Bruce Swedien engineered, in sessions from December 1981 to April 1982 at Westlake, Ocean Way and Allen Zentz. Michael Boddicker plays Polymoog and vocoder, Greg Phillinganes synths, Michael Sembello guitar and Ndugu Chancler drums, with Howard Hewett and James and Phillip Ingram on backing vocals.
notes.context: David Geffen had shelved I'm a Rainbow, the album Summer made with Giorgio Moroder and Pete Bellotte, and wanted Jones's name on her next record. Summer was pregnant and found Jones controlling; she told the Los Angeles Times it sometimes felt like a Quincy Jones album she sang on. The single came out on 1 June 1982 and reached number 10 on the Hot 100, 4 on the R&B chart and 3 on the dance chart, her best R&B showing since Bad Girls.

listen_for.note: Police whistles, the same trick Summer used on Bad Girls in 1979.
Boddicker's vocoder and Polymoog do the work strings would have done on her Casablanca records.

leads_to.title: State of Independence
leads_to.why: The Vangelis and Jon Anderson song from the same Jones sessions, with a choir that includes Michael Jackson, Stevie Wonder, Patti Austin and James Ingram; number one in the Netherlands.

culture.title: Pop art room
culture.line: The video has Summer dancing in a room full of pop art, in black satin chosen to hide her pregnancy.

culture.title: Top ten
culture.line: Number 10 on the Hot 100 in the week of 25 September 1982, her 16th top 40 hit, and number 18 in the UK.
